note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (house rules of an imaginary building, jurisdiction unspecified). The route each board shows (routeA / routeB) is SUPPLIED by the author; the scene never decides which rule applies, names no winner and states no outcome.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Two identical junction boards. Only in B a stamp prints the condition marker and the changed fact on the parcel card; both magnifiers examine the card at the same moment; B's socket lights, its switch throws and its gate opens, then the wagons follow their supplied routes (A main line, B separate branch).

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: in B the author supplies the marker as DISPUTED. The stamp prints a half-filled marker, the socket answers with a dashed half diamond, no pulse reaches the switch and B's wagon is held at the stop line while A continues along the main route — the sequence, not just the text, differs.
